prompt_en: Why is a BHW's role said to be wider under the UHC Act of 2019?
prompt_fil: Bakit masasabing mas malawak ang tungkulin ng BHW sa ilalim ng UHC Act of 2019?
current_key_en: Because UHC's direction is primary care and health promotion, so teaching and organising are now included
finding: The key implies teaching and organizing were newly included by UHC; the revised lesson emphasizes how longstanding roles combine.
proposed_action: Use a new situation requiring an explanation of complementary roles; avoid an unsupported historical inference.

prompt_en: What does HEPO — the BHW's designated role under UHC — stand for?
prompt_fil: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng HEPO, ang itinalagang papel ng BHW sa ilalim ng UHC?
current_key_en: Health Education and Promotion Officer
finding: Acronym expansion is recall and does not demonstrate understanding of the combined role.
proposed_action: Move acronym recall to optional lesson practice; use the chapter slot for integrated roles.

prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT one of the three BHW roles in the DOH BHW Reference Manual?
prompt_fil: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang HINDI isa sa tatlong tungkulin ng BHW ayon sa BHW Reference Manual ng DOH?
current_key_en: Barangay Treasurer for Health
finding: Negative stem and an implausible treasurer option make role recognition easy without understanding.
proposed_action: Merge the construct into T01 with plausible role combinations.

prompt_en: BHW Marites gathers the mothers in the purok to explain how to avoid diarrhoea during the rainy season. Which role is she performing?
prompt_fil: Tinipon ni BHW Marites ang mga nanay sa purok para ipaliwanag kung paano maiiwasan ang pagtatae ngayong tag-ulan. Anong tungkulin ang kanyang ginagampanan?
current_key_en: Health Educator
finding: Naming Health Educator does not test adapting education to different audiences; gathering people can involve several roles.
proposed_action: Ask which audience-specific adjustment is justified by the scenario.

prompt_en: BHW Ramon talks to the purok leader and the kagawad about setting up a weekly canal clean-up. Which role is he performing?
prompt_fil: Kinausap ni BHW Ramon ang purok leader at ang kagawad para magkaroon ng lingguhang paglilinis ng kanal. Anong tungkulin ang kanyang ginagampanan?
current_key_en: Community Organizer
finding: Naming Community Organizer misses invitation, resident response, evidence and planning boundaries.
proposed_action: Assess the appropriate participation step; observe the actual invitation separately.

prompt_en: As part of the primary care team, who is usually the first contact a health need in the community meets?
prompt_fil: Bilang bahagi ng primary care team, sino ang karaniwang unang nasasalubong ng pangangailangang pangkalusugan sa komunidad?
current_key_en: The BHW, as the barangay's frontline
finding: Naming a first contact does not establish how to respond within training or arrange follow-up.
proposed_action: Give a resident request beyond BHW training and ask for the appropriate next step.

prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT one of the records a BHW usually keeps?
prompt_fil: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang HINDI karaniwang talaang hawak ng isang BHW?
current_key_en: The barangay's budget and expenditure ledger
finding: Identifying a budget ledger as the odd record does not distinguish the four taught record purposes.
proposed_action: Give a record request and an uncertain entry; choose the record and verification.

prompt_en: What is the best reason a BHW's household profile needs to be accurate and up to date?
prompt_fil: Ano ang pinakamahusay na dahilan kung bakit kailangang tama at napapanahon ang household profile na hawak ng BHW?
current_key_en: Because these data guide health programmes on where to go and what to prioritise
finding: The planning rationale is useful but the longest and most constructive option cues the answer.
proposed_action: Ask what can and cannot be concluded from a short fictional record; balance alternatives.

prompt_en: Beyond carrying out plans, what part is a BHW expected to take in the barangay planning team for health under UHC and the LIPH?
prompt_fil: Bukod sa pagpapatupad ng plano, anong papel ang inaasahan sa BHW sa barangay planning team for health sa ilalim ng UHC at ng LIPH?
current_key_en: To participate in and contribute to local health planning
finding: Participation is correct but authority violations make the alternatives too easy.
proposed_action: Choose a factual contribution and locally verified route without promising approval or funds.

prompt_en: A resident heard that "consultations are free now" because of the UHC Act. What is the most accurate explanation?
prompt_fil: Nabalitaan ng isang residente na 'libre na ang konsulta' dahil sa UHC Act. Ano ang pinakatamang paliwanag dito?
current_key_en: Consultation can be covered if the resident is registered with a PhilHealth primary care provider, but not every service is free
finding: Useful misconception, but the revised lesson separately checks inclusion, specific benefit, provider and process.
proposed_action: Use a specific consultation question and a careful verification response; keep service rules tied to approved lesson content.

prompt_en: What does having a "primary care provider" mean under UHC?
prompt_fil: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng pagkakaroon ng "primary care provider" sa ilalim ng UHC?
current_key_en: Each Filipino registers with a chosen first place to go for a health need
finding: Definition recognition omits verification of the selected clinic and clinician-led referral.
proposed_action: Ask how to check an unknown clinic/process and who decides referral.

prompt_en: Why isn't it enough for a BHW to just know the changes the UHC Act brings?
prompt_fil: Bakit hindi sapat na malaman lang ng BHW ang mga pagbabagong dulot ng UHC Act?
current_key_en: Because the BHW also needs to spot chances to improve how it's carried out in their own barangay, and get the suggestion to the right person
finding: The generic improvement principle does not require a concrete feasible proposal or review.
proposed_action: Compare proposals using verified information, local authority, feasible action and a useful measure.

prompt_en: Why is it prohibited to accept a gift from a milk or medicine company in exchange for promotion?
prompt_fil: Bakit ipinagbabawal ang pagtanggap ng regalo mula sa isang kumpanya ng gatas o gamot kapalit ng pag-promote?
current_key_en: Because it could influence the proper service or advice people should receive at the health facility
finding: The broad milk-or-medicine wording does not test different product scopes and conditional permissions.
proposed_action: Name the actual product and requested activity; assess a matched response and supervisor verification.

prompt_en: What does RA 10028 require of a barangay health station, unlike the Milk Code's prohibition?
prompt_fil: Ano ang inaatas ng RA 10028 sa isang barangay health station, kaiba sa pagbabawal ng Milk Code?
current_key_en: Actively promote breastfeeding and have a lactation station
finding: Recalling a law requirement misses the BHW role, institutional responsibility, privacy and confirmed local support.
proposed_action: Use a parent seeking help; choose respectful connection to verified trained support and space.

prompt_en: Who accredits a BHW before they can officially begin their work?
prompt_fil: Sino ang nagbibigay ng akreditasyon sa isang BHW bago siya opisyal na makapagsimula sa gawain?
current_key_en: The local health board, under RA 7883
finding: Correct authority recall alone does not distinguish a recommendation from a verified board decision.
proposed_action: Use a fictional recommendation without confirmed accreditation; select the evidence question.

prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT required for BHW Eligibility (BHWE) in the Civil Service?
prompt_fil: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang HINDI kailangan para maging eligible sa BHW Eligibility (BHWE) sa Civil Service?
current_key_en: Completed a four-year college degree
finding: Not needing a four-year degree does not test the two-college-year condition or qualifying accredited-service period.
proposed_action: Use service dates and missing education evidence; assess what counts and what CSC must verify.

prompt_en: What is the best move when the accreditation process is slow, or a benefit is delayed?
prompt_fil: Ano ang pinakamahusay na hakbang kapag mabagal ang proseso ng akreditasyon o naantala ang isang benepisyong dapat matanggap?
current_key_en: Follow up calmly with a specific question about the status
finding: Calm follow-up is useful, but the distractors do not test a specific question, response clarification or bounded next contact.
proposed_action: Compare plausible follow-ups identifying the known status, missing fact and next contact.

prompt_en: A resident has had a long-standing cough and wants to know if it needs a referral. Who should the BHW approach first for this?
prompt_fil: May residenteng may matagal nang ubo at gustong malaman kung dapat bang i-refer. Sino ang unang lalapitan ng BHW para dito?
current_key_en: The midwife or RHU
finding: A recognizable contact is useful but symptom wording alone does not establish urgency or a universal local route.
proposed_action: State the relevant urgency information or an already-directed follow-up; assess contact verification without creating a triage rule.

prompt_en: In a team of BHWs, what should be the very first response when a member has a personal issue that might affect the group's work?
prompt_fil: Sa isang koponan ng mga BHW, ano ang pinakaunang dapat gawin kapag may personal na isyu ang isang miyembro na maaaring makaapekto sa gawain ng grupo?
current_key_en: Talk about it as a team right away, before it deepens
finding: The keyed team discussion of a personal issue conflicts with protecting private reasons in the revised lesson.
proposed_action: Assess early discussion of the task impact, permission, accepted handoff and completion; private reasons need not be disclosed.

prompt_en: Which of the following is NOT one of the six self-management skills a BHW should have?
prompt_fil: Alin sa mga sumusunod ang HINDI isa sa anim na kasanayan sa self-management na dapat taglayin ng isang BHW?
current_key_en: Being the single best-performing BHW of all
finding: The obviously boastful non-skill option does not test self-management in practice.
proposed_action: Use changed workload and compare honest priorities, communication and a realistic next step.

prompt_en: A resident is quiet beside a neighbor. How should the interview begin?
prompt_fil: Tahimik ang residente habang katabi ang kapitbahay. Ano ang magandang simula ng interview?
current_key_en: Ask whether the resident would prefer a more private place.
finding: A clear basic privacy-choice item aligned with the lesson; it does not demonstrate permission or listening behavior.
proposed_action: Retain as a candidate basic item; add a fresh counterpart and rationales, and observe full listening practice separately.

prompt_en: Which is an open question about a missed visit?
prompt_fil: Alin ang bukas na tanong tungkol sa hindi pagdalo?
current_key_en: “What got in the way of attending?”
finding: An aligned basic distinction between open and leading questions; it samples only part of clarification.
proposed_action: Retain in the candidate bank; prefer a neutral-clarification variant for T18 if the pilot shows a ceiling effect.

prompt_en: A resident says they attended but has no card. How should this be recorded?
prompt_fil: Sabi ng residente ay dumalo siya, ngunit wala ang card. Paano itatala?
current_key_en: Record the account and mark the record as needing confirmation.
finding: Correctly separates reported attendance from verified evidence.
proposed_action: Retain as a candidate interpretation item; use a fresh record in the alternate form and assess authored records separately.

prompt_en: Which report is useful to the midwife?
prompt_fil: Aling ulat ang makakatulong sa midwife?
current_key_en: “The resident reports a childcare barrier and requests help with scheduling.”
finding: Two plainly insulting reports make the constructive option obvious; source uncertainty, recipient and secure route are absent.
proposed_action: Compare plausible handoffs with different information gaps or disclosure levels.

prompt_en: How can the clarity of the agreed plan be checked?
prompt_fil: Paano malalaman kung malinaw ang napagkasunduang plano?
current_key_en: Invite the resident to describe the next step in their own words.
finding: Teach-back recognition is aligned and useful but does not test repair when misunderstanding appears.
proposed_action: Retain as a basic candidate; draft the paired repair task for the stronger T19 target.

prompt_en: A client is worried about family planning. What is the BHW’s role?
prompt_fil: May takot ang kliyente sa family planning. Ano ang tamang papel ng BHW?
current_key_en: Listen to the concern and connect the client to private midwife counseling.
finding: Preserves client choice and appropriate referral, but the alternatives are extreme and the item does not test an explanation or repair.
proposed_action: Use a respectful but incomplete response as a distractor; connect to explaining and checking the next step.

prompt_en: Which is a useful description of a problem to investigate?
prompt_fil: Alin ang maayos na paglalarawan ng problemang pag-aaralan?
current_key_en: Three invited households missed the visit; reasons still need investigation.
finding: Useful non-blaming statement; it lacks an explicit source and competes against obvious blame or a premature solution.
proposed_action: Give a brief report and compare plausible statements differing in source, scope or uncertainty.

prompt_en: Two households report different reasons for nonattendance. What should happen in Five Whys?
prompt_fil: Magkaiba ang dahilan ng dalawang pamilya sa hindi pagdalo. Ano ang gagawin sa Five Whys?
current_key_en: Follow separate causal branches and verify with those affected.
finding: Preserves multiple causal branches and verification with affected people.
proposed_action: Retain as a candidate reasoning item; create a counterpart with an unsupported link, not a verbatim lesson check.

prompt_en: Scores are magnitude 3, severity 4, feasibility 5, urgency 2. What is the total?
prompt_fil: Ang scores ay laki 3, kabigatan 4, feasibility 5, urgency 2. Ano ang kabuuan?
finding: Addition alone does not test criteria, evidence, ties or the distinction from urgent referral.
proposed_action: Move bare arithmetic into practice; use a ranking/tie interpretation task with relevant evidence.

prompt_en: Which recommendation is ready for discussion as an action plan?
prompt_fil: Aling rekomendasyon ang maaari nang talakayin bilang action plan?
current_key_en: “BHW Rosa will consult five households this week; review attendance at the next session with the midwife.”
finding: The best option has owner and timing but leaves verified cause, resources, agreement and outcome measurement incomplete.
proposed_action: Compare two plausible plans or outcomes and ask which missing information matters.

prompt_en: There is no proper sharps container for a planned task. What should happen?
prompt_fil: Walang tamang sharps container para sa nakaplanong gawain. Ano ang dapat gawin?
current_key_en: Tell the supervisor and do not begin the unsafe task.
finding: Directly checks the necessary decision to stop an unsafe task and seek correction.
proposed_action: Retain as a safety anchor candidate; balance other bank coverage across hazard groups and observe controls separately.

prompt_en: After a needlestick, what is needed even without symptoms?
prompt_fil: Pagkatapos ng needlestick, ano ang dapat gawin kahit walang sintomas?
current_key_en: Wash with soap and water, report and obtain immediate medical evaluation.
finding: Checks immediate washing, reporting and evaluation despite absent symptoms; remains decision evidence only.
proposed_action: Retain the core sequence with qualified clinical review; author a parallel delay misconception and observe the dummy demonstration separately.

prompt_en: A BHW has gloves. Which statement about hand hygiene is correct?
prompt_fil: May gloves ang BHW. Alin ang tama tungkol sa hand hygiene?
current_key_en: Gloves do not replace hand hygiene; continue following the protocol.
finding: Accurately checks that gloves do not replace hand hygiene; it is a narrow foundational item.
proposed_action: Retain for the bank or lesson practice; use alongside wider hazard-control coverage, not as evidence for all controls.

prompt_en: The BHW is exhausted and the night route is unsafe. What is appropriate?
prompt_fil: Pagod na ang BHW at mapanganib ang gabing ruta. Ano ang tamang tugon?
current_key_en: Report the risk and capacity limits; request a safer alternative or reassignment.
finding: Aligned decision to report risk and capacity and request a safer alternative.
proposed_action: Retain as a candidate; the alternate task should ask which readiness condition remains unconfirmed.

prompt_en: Which is safe waste reduction?
prompt_fil: Alin ang halimbawa ng ligtas na pagbawas-aksaya?
current_key_en: Fix a leaking tap while keeping adequate hand-hygiene water.
finding: The keyed phrase fix a leaking tap leaves actor and authorization unclear; revised text assigns inspection/repair to an authorized person.
proposed_action: State that the BHW reports the leak and requests authorized inspection/repair while preserving handwashing water; do not imply completed repair or savings.

prompt_en: Before requesting more supplies, what routine is useful?
prompt_fil: Bago humingi ng dagdag na supplies, ano ang kapaki-pakinabang na routine?
current_key_en: Count stock, check expiry and follow the approved inventory procedure.
finding: Stock and expiry are relevant but the revised lesson adds approved versions, usable stock and label-count-return.
proposed_action: Use a fictional teaching kit with hidden stock or outdated copies; assess verification before ordering.

prompt_en: A new checklist has nobody assigned to follow it. What is missing?
prompt_fil: May bagong checklist pero walang nakatalagang susunod dito. Ano ang kulang?
current_key_en: An agreed owner, replacement and review date.
finding: Owner and handover matter, but print quantity and font are implausible alternatives.
proposed_action: Compare plausible trial plans differing in ownership, replacement, baseline or review measures.

prompt_en: Paper use fell but so did session numbers. What should be checked?
prompt_fil: Bumaba ang papel ngunit bumaba rin ang bilang ng sessions. Ano ang dapat suriin?
current_key_en: Use per comparable session and the quality of service delivered.
finding: Correct principle, but selecting a phrase does not show the learner can interpret comparable workload data.
proposed_action: Supply a small table and ask what the rates and service-quality information justify.
